entities.name: 评测 (evals)
entities.how_described: 本集核心主张：如果你在构建 AI 产品，除了评测之外做任何事都没有意义；评测是把出问题的案例捕获下来、让任何改动有据可查的「真正的工程」，且投入不会随换模型而蒸发

evidence.quote: In our discussion, we cover why evals are core to AI development,
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

evidence.quote: And we had to build tools to help us do evals really well.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And that's where I realized that if you're building an AI product, there's no point doing anything other than evals.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: Everything should revolve around your evals.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And there were a number of companies that had gone started around different components of tooling, including evals.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

evidence.quote: But one of the things that struck me in our first conversation about Braintrust was the way you framed evals to me as the core of what product development means in AI.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

evidence.quote: And so that craft of actually deciding what you want the LLM to behave or how you want it to behave is really like the fundamental craft of building evals.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: I think once you embrace evals, then you realize that what the LLM does is merely a function of the evals that you're producing.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: When you really embrace it, you realize that the work that you put into doing evals doesn't evaporate every time you try a new model or you change some wording or you change your use case a little bit.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: So for example, one of the most powerful features of BrainTrust is the fact that you can take logs and connect them to data sets and those data sets you use for your evals.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And when you run evals, the code and prompts and stuff that you use for your evals are closely connected to GitHub and your code base.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: So another kind of misnomer I hear in the background AI chatter is like, oh, well, there's going to be a new company for agent evals and there's going to be a new company for voice evals and these things.

evidence.quote: But the deeper reason is that there are a lot of really hard infrastructure problems that go into supporting evals in the first place.
